resolved.Title: baseline (no fault)
resolved.Description: Same seed, rate and topology as the fault scenarios with no fault injected. Its p99 in the reference window is the baseline for the "healthy sink p99 increase" criteria (REVIEW_01 item 12).

notes: kill = SIGKILL; graceful stop = SIGTERM. kill -9 is not power loss (page cache survives).
